parsed.title: F92 row misfiles route value into class column
parsed.detail: Row F92 reads `| F92 | ... | code | med | replan-in-unit | regression of F80 — plan owner re-cuts ... | no |`. Every other row uses the class vocabulary `fix-now` / `decision-required` (e.g. F83 `| med | fix-now | replan-in-unit: ... |`); here the class column holds the route token `replan-in-unit` and the route column holds free prose that is not a route value (no other route cell lacks the `fold…/replan-in-unit…/surface decision…` lead). The ledger schema declared by the header (`| class | route |`) is violated.

parsed.title: F87: replan-routed row marked folded=yes
parsed.detail: F87's route is `replan-in-unit: plan owner re-cuts SPEC.md:588 ...` yet its folded column is `yes`. Within this same material the fixtures establish the pairing: 10-replan-unit marks its replan rows `no`, and 13-execute-unit marks `fold into phase` rows `yes`. A replan-routed finding cannot be already folded into the phase; the row contradicts the router vocabulary the fixture set is built to exercise.

parsed.title: F80 route cell uses non-canonical fold token
parsed.detail: F80's route cell begins `fold: widen the layer-line parse...` while the canonical fold route emitted/declared elsewhere in this material is `fold into phase` (10-replan-unit F1, 11-fold-unit F1, 13-execute-unit F1). F84 (`fold: widen the box-7...`) and F89 (`fold: relocate...`) repeat the same off-vocabulary `fold:` prefix. If the router matches on route class these rows are a distinct, untyped route.

parsed.title: ROADMAP omits the 30-dup-alpha unit present in the fixture tree
parsed.detail: The fixture ships both `docs/features/30-dup-alpha/` and `docs/fix/30-dup-alpha/`, but the ROADMAP table lists only units 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 37, 40 — no row for slug/unit 30. Either the duplicate-slug fixture is invisible to the roadmap contract the router consumes, or the fixture is incomplete for the dup case it evidently intends to cover.
